settings.heading: The best B2B & wholesale apps for Shopify stores.

settings.name: B2B Onboarding & Wholesale
settings.tagline: Wholesale onboarding forms, document management & B2B pricing
settings.description: Wholesale registration forms with approval, buyer document management, and B2B pricing on any Shopify plan. Unlimited price groups, net terms, and quick order.

settings.name: B2B Wishlist Project Planner
settings.tagline: B2B wishlists with quote requests, PDF exports & draft orders
settings.description: Shopify wishlist app for B2B & project planning: multiple wishlists, subgroups, quantities, sharing, PDF quotes, draft orders & add to cart.

settings.name: B2B Draft Order Invoices
settings.tagline: Draft order invoices & quote requests customers can pay
settings.description: Customers view & pay draft order invoices from their account page, with PDF downloads, quote requests, automated payment reminders, and Shopify POS support.

settings.heading: Built for stores that sell to serious buyers
settings.intro: Three focused Shopify apps from a team that specializes in trade and wholesale businesses. Streamline onboarding and document management for your B2B customers, plan large orders and projects with purpose-built wishlists, and supercharge invoicing in Shopify. Built and supported by Conspire, a Shopify Premier Partner.

settings.heading: One senior Shopify team behind every app
settings.text:
Every app here is designed, developed, and supported by Conspire, a Shopify development company and Shopify Premier Partner founded in Los Angeles. The same senior developers and designers who build high-performing storefronts for leading brands answer your support messages.

Need more than an app? Conspire also offers full Shopify development services, from storefront design to custom B2B builds.

settings.title: Run wholesale pricing
settings.text: Buyers apply through a sign-up form, get approved into a tier, and log in to see their prices already applied on your existing Shopify store.

settings.title: Let buyers plan with wishlists
settings.text: Trade customers organize products by room or job, set quantities, share lists with their team, and export PDF quotes.

settings.title: Settle it with payable invoices
settings.text: Wishlists and quote requests become draft orders. Customers view and pay the invoices from their account page, with automated reminders.

settings.question: Do the apps work on any Shopify plan?
settings.answer: Yes. All three apps run on any Shopify plan, including Basic, with no Shopify Plus requirement. The wholesale app adds B2B pricing, sign-up forms and approvals to your existing store.

settings.question: How much do the apps cost?
settings.answer: B2B Onboarding & Wholesale has a free plan for up to 10 wholesale companies, with Grow at $29/month and Pro at $99/month. B2B Wishlist Project Planner has a free plan, and the Project planner plan is $29/month with a 14-day trial. B2B Draft Order Invoices starts at $5/month with a free trial on every plan. Current pricing is always on each Shopify App Store listing.

settings.question: Do the apps work together?
settings.answer: Yes. Wishlists convert to draft orders, draft orders become payable invoices on the customer account page, and wholesale buyers see their approved pricing throughout. Each app also works on its own.

settings.question: Who builds and supports them?
settings.answer: Conspire, a Shopify development agency and Premier Partner in Los Angeles. The senior developers who build the apps answer support messages, and documentation for each app is at apps.conspireagency.com.
